content: {"summary":"静态阅读学生代码：使用 csv.DictReader 解析，检查必需表头，逐行校验 record_id 与 duration_minutes，并区分未知分钟与已知 0 分钟，累加已知分钟。主要问题是缺少表头时返回空字典而非抛出 ValueError；其余计数、累加、空有效集返回和纯函数边界从代码看基本符合契约。未执行代码，结论仅基于静态文本。","overall":"needs_changes","criteria":[{"criterion_id":"C01","verdict":"fail","issue_type":"missing_header_validation","evidence_span":"if reader.fieldnames is None or not required.issubset(reader.fieldnames):\n        return {}","reason":"缺少必需表头时函数返回空字典，而任务要求抛出 ValueError；公开向量 T06 也期望 ValueError。","next_action":"将缺表头分支改为抛出 ValueError，而不是返回 {}；保留对 fieldnames 为 None 或缺少必需列的判断。","suggested_self_test":"用输入 'record_id,minutes\\n1,30\\n' 调用 summarize_records，断言抛出 ValueError。"},{"criterion_id":"C02","verdict":"pass","reason":"使用 csv.DictReader 与 io.StringIO 解析，能处理引号字段；对 None 键（多余无表头字段）、record_id 非整数或非正、分钟非整数或越界均计入 invalid_count，分钟空白保留为未知，行有效性判断符合契约。","evidence_span":null,"issue_type":null,"next_action":null,"suggested_self_test":null},{"criterion_id":"C03","verdict":"pass","reason":"有效行计入 record_count；分钟空白计入 missing_duration_count，已知 0 分钟计入 known_duration_count 而非缺失，未知与 0 区分正确；非法行只计 invalid_count。","evidence_span":null,"issue_type":null,"next_action":null,"suggested_self_test":null},{"criterion_id":"C04","verdict":"pass","reason":"仅对 duration 非 None 的有效行执行 known_minutes += duration，已知 0 分钟加 0 不影响和，未知分钟不参与累加，未发现覆盖、重置、漏加或重复累加有效非零分钟的独立错误。","evidence_span":null,"issue_type":null,"next_action":null,"suggested_self_test":null},{"criterion_id":"C05","verdict":"pass","reason":"五个计数字段在循环前初始化为整数 0，没有有效行时仍返回完整五字段字典；缺表头分支返回 {} 属于 C01 的表头约束问题，不重复计为 C05。","evidence_span":null,"issue_type":null,"next_action":null,"suggested_self_test":null},{"criterion_id":"C06","verdict":"pass","reason":"函数仅使用 csv、io 在内存中解析字符串，不读写文件、不联网、不执行任意代码，符合纯函数与静态边界要求。","evidence_span":null,"issue_type":null,"next_action":null,"suggested_self_test":null}]}
